finding: The official Linux runner service path proves boot enablement and selected child-listener retry, not unconditional whole-service crash recovery. The systemd unit has no Restart= policy. RunnerService.js retries listener exit codes 2/3/4 and many undefined errors, but intentionally stops on 0/1/5 and caps repeated retriable failures. Do not equate svc.sh installation with an always-self-healing listener and do not add Restart=always without testing against upstream intentional no-retry semantics.
